name: data-analytics-sql-endpoint
title: Data Analytics on the SQL Analytics Endpoint
description: Architecture blueprint for T-SQL analytics directly over Lakehouse files/tables: land unstructured/semi-structured/structured data in a Lakehouse, transform it into Delta tables, and query it read-only through the auto-provisioned SQL analytics endpoint — then report on it. Best when you want SQL/BI over lakehouse data without a separate Warehouse.
best_for: SQL analysts and BI over Delta lake data — read-only T-SQL on the Lakehouse's SQL analytics endpoint, no separate Warehouse needed.
primary_storage: Lakehouse (Delta tables) queried via its SQL analytics endpoint (read-only T-SQL)
key_ingestion: Copy Job or Data Pipeline into the Lakehouse

item_set.purpose: Delta storage + auto-provisioned SQL analytics endpoint
Read-only T-SQL surface over the lakehouse (auto-created)
Land source files into the lakehouse
Convert raw files -> queryable Delta tables
Direct Lake / import model over the SQL endpoint

decisions.guidance: SQL analytics endpoint is READ-ONLY over lakehouse Delta — great for BI/analytics. Choose a Warehouse when you need write transactions, stored procedures, or multi-table DML. See 'fabio context disambiguate sql-endpoint'.
Notebook for interactive/scheduled transforms; Spark Job Definition for packaged, parameterized batch jobs.
Report for interactive; Paginated for pixel-perfect/print; Scorecard for KPI tracking.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Lakehouse (Foundation) before Notebook -> SemanticModel -> Report; the SQL endpoint is auto-provisioned with the lakehouse. fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Create a lakehouse (its SQL analytics endpoint is auto-created).
Transform raw files into Delta tables (see workflow lakehouse-etl).
Build a Direct Lake semantic model + report (see workflow direct-lake-report).
